name: Protect the Frontier
summary: Protect the Frontier is an Alliance assignment handed out by Guard Thomas at the eastern bridge crossing in Elwynn Forest. As Stormwind's military presence thins toward the border, wild predators have grown increasingly bold, harassing travelers and workers at the Eastvale Logging Camp. Guard Thomas seeks capable adventurers to cull the wolves and bears threatening the eastern frontier.

sections.title: A Thinning Defense
sections.body: While Goldshire and the Northshire Valley maintain a visible Stormwind garrison, the far eastern edge of Elwynn Forest receives far less protection. Guard Thomas stands watch at the bridge crossing over the river, serving as one of the few sentries between civilized heartlands and the dangerous wilderness. With resources stretched thin across the realm, solitary guardsmen rely on passing volunteers to keep vital supply lanes open.

sections.title: The Predatory Threat
sections.body: The Eastvale Logging Camp is crucial for supplying timber to Stormwind City, but felling trees along the tree line brings woodsmen into direct conflict with local wildlife. Prowlers, gray forest wolves, and young forest bears have turned increasingly aggressive, wandering near the roads and lumber yards. Thinning their numbers temporarily relieves the pressure on local laborers, though Guard Thomas suspects an unseen disturbance deeper in the woods may be driving the beasts toward settlements.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Protect the Frontier?
faq.answer: Guard Thomas assigns the task. He is stationed at the eastern bridge along the main road through Elwynn Forest, guarding the boundary between the forest interior and the Eastvale region.

faq.q: Why are wolves and bears attacking the frontier?
faq.answer: The aggressive predators frequently encroach on roads and work sites near the Eastvale Logging Camp. While wolves and bears are naturally territorial, Guard Thomas notes that something deeper in the surrounding wilderness appears to be agitating them and driving them toward civilization.

faq.q: Where is the Eastvale Logging Camp?
faq.answer: The Eastvale Logging Camp lies in eastern Elwynn Forest, situated south of the main road past Guard Thomas's bridge. It provides vital lumber for Stormwind and border settlements.

faq.q: Why is Guard Thomas watching the bridge alone?
faq.answer: Stormwind's standing army and city guard are stretched extremely thin across the kingdom. Sentry outposts along rivers and outer crossroads often have only one or two guards stationed to watch the highways, leaving them dependent on traveling adventurers to handle large-scale wildlife threats.

faq.q: What animals need to be culled for this task?
aliases: what mobs for protect the frontier
faq.answer: You are tasked with slaying eight wolves (either prowlers or gray forest wolves) and five young forest bears roaming the woods of eastern Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: What happens once the wildlife is culled?
faq.answer: Reporting back to Guard Thomas secures his gratitude and ensures safer passage for logging caravans. However, he remains wary that whatever dark influence stirred up the beasts might cause further trouble in the forest.

angles.text: Keeping the eastern roads secure helps maintain lumber shipments from Eastvale, supporting reconstruction and defensive efforts across Alliance lands.
The wolves and bears stalking eastern Elwynn Forest provide an early test of tracking and marksmanship against ferocious local game.
